_doc: Road to Revolution cause chain, 1754–1776, for CauseChain (src/motion/causechain.tsx). `because` = the text on the connector INTO this card (why the previous event led to this one). APUSH Period 3 (KC-3.1.I). Wording follows AP prep texts (Tier 1) and the cited primary sources.

cards.title: French and Indian War
cards.source: Treaty of Paris (1763); Office of the Historian, U.S. Dept. of State, 'French and Indian War/Seven Years' War, 1754–63' (history.state.gov)
cards.note: Wording reviewed for APUSH accuracy 2026-10-07 (no change needed); dates/figures not re-retrieved this session.

cards.title: British war debt
cards.because: Britain wins North America but its national debt nearly doubles
cards.source: Office of the Historian, 'French and Indian War/Seven Years' War, 1754–63' (debt roughly doubled, c. £75M to £133M); AMSCO/Princeton Review APUSH Period 3
cards.note: Wording reviewed for APUSH accuracy 2026-10-07 (no change needed); dates/figures not re-retrieved this session.

cards.title: Proclamation of 1763
cards.because: After Pontiac's Rebellion, Britain bars settlement west of the Appalachians
cards.source: Royal Proclamation of October 7, 1763 (bars colonial settlement west of the Appalachian crest); Office of the Historian, 'Proclamation of 1763'
cards.note: Wording revised for APUSH accuracy: the Proclamation's defining feature is the ban on colonial settlement west of the Appalachian crest (to avoid costly frontier wars with Native nations after Pontiac's Rebellion). Wording reviewed 2026-10-07; source not re-retrieved this session.

cards.title: Sugar Act
cards.because: To raise revenue, Parliament cuts the molasses duty but strictly enforces it
cards.source: American Revenue Act of 1764 (4 Geo. III c. 15); Library of Congress, 'The Sugar Act' (Primary Documents in American History)
cards.note: Wording reviewed for APUSH accuracy 2026-10-07 (no change needed); dates/figures not re-retrieved this session.

cards.title: Stamp Act
cards.because: Parliament's first direct tax on the colonists — on printed paper
cards.source: Stamp Act, March 22, 1765 (5 Geo. III c. 12); Stamp Act Congress, Declaration of Rights and Grievances (Oct. 1765); Library of Congress, 'The Stamp Act'
cards.note: Wording reviewed for APUSH accuracy 2026-10-07 (no change needed); dates/figures not re-retrieved this session.

cards.title: Townshend Acts
cards.because: Boycotts force the Stamp Act's repeal (1766); Parliament taxes imports instead
cards.source: Stamp Act repeal and Declaratory Act, March 18, 1766; Townshend Revenue Act, 1767 (duties on glass, lead, paint, paper, tea); Library of Congress, 'The Townshend Acts'
cards.note: Wording reviewed for APUSH accuracy 2026-10-07 (no change needed); dates/figures not re-retrieved this session.

cards.title: Boston Massacre
cards.because: Troops sent to Boston to back customs officials fire on a crowd, killing five
cards.source: March 5, 1770; Massachusetts Historical Society, 'The Boston Massacre'; Paul Revere engraving (1770)
cards.note: Wording reviewed for APUSH accuracy 2026-10-07 (no change needed); dates/figures not re-retrieved this session.

cards.title: Tea Act & Boston Tea Party
cards.because: Only the tea tax remains; a Tea Act aids the East India Company
cards.source: Townshend duties repealed except on tea (April 1770); Tea Act, May 10, 1773; Boston Tea Party, December 16, 1773 (342 chests); Massachusetts Historical Society
cards.note: Wording reviewed for APUSH accuracy 2026-10-07 (no change needed); dates/figures not re-retrieved this session.

cards.title: Coercive (Intolerable) Acts
cards.because: To punish Boston, Parliament closes its port and curbs self-rule
cards.source: Boston Port Act, Massachusetts Government Act, Administration of Justice Act, Quartering Act (1774); Library of Congress, 'The Intolerable Acts'
cards.note: Wording reviewed for APUSH accuracy 2026-10-07 (no change needed); dates/figures not re-retrieved this session.

cards.title: First Continental Congress
cards.because: Colonies unite in protest and agree to boycott British goods
cards.source: Declaration and Resolves of the First Continental Congress (Oct. 14, 1774); Continental Association (Oct. 20, 1774); Library of Congress, Journals of the Continental Congress
cards.note: Wording reviewed for APUSH accuracy 2026-10-07 (no change needed); dates/figures not re-retrieved this session.

cards.title: Lexington and Concord
cards.because: British troops march to seize colonial arms at Concord; militia fight back
cards.source: April 19, 1775; National Park Service, Minute Man National Historical Park, 'April 19, 1775'
cards.note: Wording reviewed for APUSH accuracy 2026-10-07 (no change needed); dates/figures not re-retrieved this session.

cards.title: Common Sense
cards.because: With war under way, Paine argues for independence, not reconciliation
cards.source: Thomas Paine, Common Sense (Philadelphia, January 10, 1776); Library of Congress, 'Common Sense'
cards.note: Wording reviewed for APUSH accuracy 2026-10-07 (no change needed); dates/figures not re-retrieved this session.

cards.title: Declaration of Independence
cards.because: Congress votes to break with Britain, citing natural rights and the king's abuses
cards.source: Lee Resolution adopted July 2, 1776; Declaration adopted July 4, 1776 (drafted chiefly by Thomas Jefferson); National Archives, 'Declaration of Independence: A Transcription'
cards.note: Wording reviewed for APUSH accuracy 2026-10-07 (no change needed); dates/figures not re-retrieved this session.
